title: Compact .tick/learnings.md back under its own 150-line cap
description:
The file's header declares a 150-line hard cap; it sits at 170.

This is already costing something real rather than being tidiness: l9n had a learning worth recording (the /ticfac .gitignore collision) and deliberately did NOT add it, on the reasoning that growing an over-cap file is worse than skipping. So the cap is currently working as a gag — every worker with a learning either breaks the cap or drops the learning.

Work: fold the oldest superseded entries. An entry whose subject has since been rewritten, or whose lesson is now enforced by a test, is a candidate — the file is for what a fresh worker must know that the code does not already say.

Found by l9n, run epic-ncv, finding 4a87c9e3.
acceptance_criteria: .tick/learnings.md is at or under 150 lines and no unsuperseded learning was dropped
